title: Span and Days Approved on TRICARE Prime Requests Approved to the Network Provider, Referrals and Authorizations
content:
Under **Referrals and Authorizations**, a TRICARE Prime request of a type whose military clinic has the right of first refusal, approved to the requested network provider once the clinic's response window has passed with no answer, receives the following span and days.

## Span

The validity span starts under the type's start rule (the date of approval, or the admission date for the inpatient types) and runs the type's validity days, counting the first day as day 1; its last day is the first day plus the validity days, less one day.

## Days approved

The days approved are the initial block, which is the type's units on a standard approval (its default units authorized). The days approved are never fewer than one, and never more than the units requested or the type's maximum units per authorization. Put as one figure, the days approved are the lesser of the units requested, the type's default units authorized and the type's maximum units per authorization.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | an inpatient type whose span starts on the admission date |
| Admission date | 4 May |
| Validity days | 7 |
| Units requested | 10 |
| Default units authorized | 7 |
| Maximum units per authorization | 37 |

The days approved are the lesser of 10, 7 and 37, that is 7. The span runs from 4 May (day 1) to 10 May (day 7).

## Second example (hypothetical)

A request for 4 visits on a type with 6 default units and a 12-unit maximum, approved on 2 March with a 180-day span: 4 visits are approved, and the span runs from 2 March to 28 August.
